meta.title: Should You Buy L.L. Bean Boots?
meta.description:
Buy the boots here: https://sovrn.co/1j1ztgz

Should you buy L.L. Bean boots? Or should you get Sorels? Or should you get Sperrys? Or any of the other companies that copy from L.L. Bean's design? My take is usually the same about these things; if you can get the original and they haven't gone to garbage quality, you should get the original!

These are the 8" (inch) L.L. Bean boot in tumbled leather with no shearling, gore-tex, thinsulate, etc. Just plain okay. I'm not rich. Are they the best boot for winter? Best boot in Maine? Best boot for landscaping!?
